Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait card from your trash without paying the cost. If [Eiji Nagasumi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 2 to the number of cards this effect may play.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon, this Digimon unsuspends. For each of your Digimon, add 1 to this effect's level maximum.
[Your Turn] The turn end condition is the opponent having 3 or more memory.
Notes: 2024 Championship Regionals Champion Card Set Wave 2
